from pathlib import Path
import json

data=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
tid="DEV-PRED-CONT-CANARY2-A-20261003-E022"
items=[]
for p in (data/"inflight").glob("*.json"):
    try:o=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:continue
    try:mt=p.stat().st_mtime_ns
    except OSError:continue
    items.append((mt,p,o))

target=None
for item in items:
    if isinstance(item[2],dict) and item[2].get("task_id")==tid:
        target=item
        break
if target is None:
    print("INFLIGHT_RANK=A_MISSING",flush=True); raise SystemExit(51)

oldest=sorted(items,key=lambda x:x[0])
newest=sorted(items,key=lambda x:x[0],reverse=True)
old_rank=next(i+1 for i,x in enumerate(oldest) if x[1]==target[1])
new_rank=next(i+1 for i,x in enumerate(newest) if x[1]==target[1])
total=len(items)
if old_rank>256 and new_rank<=256:
    print(f"INFLIGHT_RANK=STARVED total={total} old_rank={old_rank} new_rank={new_rank}",flush=True); raise SystemExit(52)
if old_rank<=256:
    print(f"INFLIGHT_RANK=WITHIN_OLD_SCAN total={total} old_rank={old_rank} new_rank={new_rank}",flush=True); raise SystemExit(53)
print(f"INFLIGHT_RANK=OUTSIDE_BOTH total={total} old_rank={old_rank} new_rank={new_rank}",flush=True); raise SystemExit(54)
